(Translated by Google) The staff member who assisted us provided terrible service.

Although we only visited once for a tour, I deeply regret going.

I find it puzzling why their prices are higher than other venues, given their self-centered sales tactics and poor customer service.

Even if the venue is beautiful, with such poor service from the staff, I wouldn't want to hold my wedding there.
